title: LTE Sync (Three-Three-Six Cells)
style: glitch IDM telecom phonk, 130 bpm, Zadoff-Chu sequence arpeggio, m-sequence drum stutters, cellular handover sweeps, bit-crushed sub bass, telephone-line ring percussion, deterministic kick on the radio frame boundary, 336 hz subharmonic anchor, dark cell-tower mood
lyrics:
[Intro]
Five milliseconds, primary sync
Ten milliseconds, secondary sync
Four hundred ninety-two cells — minus the unused
Three hundred thirty-six — the ones we use

[Verse 1]
Zadoff-Chu sequence, constant modulus
Auto-correlate clean, no fuzz
Three primary roots, twenty-five, twenty-nine, thirty-four
The handset finds the timing and asks for more

[Pre-Drop]
m-sequence on the secondary, scrambled with the first
One hundred sixty-eight times two, three-three-six is the burst

[Drop]
LTE — sync — LTE — sync
Three-three-six cells before you blink
Primary — secondary — primary — link
Three-three-six on the spectrum, never sink

[Verse 2]
Four-G handover, the cell does the math
No dropped call, no jagged path
Reference signal in the resource grid
Deterministic timing, what the standard did

[Drop]
LTE — sync — LTE — sync
Three-three-six cells before you blink
Primary — secondary — primary — link
Three-three-six on the spectrum, never sink

[Outro]
Five milliseconds, ten milliseconds
The handset is home
